name: Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs

difficulty.summary: No formal official difficulty grade found. STF gives this as a long 23 km stage and Naturkartan gives 8-10 hours. Source descriptions and field reports consistently describe a steep climb from Rävfallet/Vindelälven, exposed upland walking with limited reliable running water, and a steep descent toward Ammarnäs/Näsberget.

routeGeometry.routeDescription: From Rävfallsstugan/Rävfallet the route crosses the Vindelälven bridge and climbs steeply through mountain birch forest. It follows Vuotsbäcken and continues over exposed upland terrain around Stuore Jåppe, Marsivaggie, Njallavaratje/Gieråive and Småfjällen. Near the Karsbäcken fork, Kungsleden stays toward Näsbergstjärnen and descends steeply toward Näsberget/Ammarnäs. Naturkartan notes that the trail through Ammarnäs village is unmarked.

commuteAccess.summary: Rävfallsstugan has no direct public transport. The closest verified roadhead is Höbäcken, which is roadhead/parking only. Ammarnäs is the usable public transport and service endpoint, with Tabussen/Länstrafiken Västerbotten bus service via Sorsele and village lodging/resupply.

campingAndFire.summary: No prepared campsite POIs were confirmed on the mountain section. One-night wild camping is generally possible subject to reserve rules and not disturbing wildlife, reindeer husbandry or land use. Camping near Rävfallsstugan is source-contradictory. Village camping/lodging exists in Ammarnäs.

records.details: Field reports conflict: Likeahike found good bivouac options across the bridge/forest in 2021, while a 2025 Komoot note says good tent spots near the cabin are rare. Treat as route note only.
Stabburet is a rest shelter/emergency-bunk context, not a staffed lodging site. Model as shelter and emergency attributes, not a campsite.
OSM and field reports support a shelter/firepit cluster; toilet remains unverified. This may be useful for rest/shelter display if OSM-supported POIs are accepted.

No Sorsele legal fire ban was found on 2026-04-30, but SMHI had grass-fire risk for snow-free parts of Västerbotten. Fire permissions are date-sensitive and current bans override general reserve permissions.

rulesAndSafety.summary: No official route-specific hiking closure was found on 2026-04-30. The stage is in/near Vindelfjällen nature reserve and Natura 2000 context, with reindeer, dog, hunting/fishing, fire, spring-thaw and Marsivagge bird-protection caveats.

records.details: Länsstyrelsen's current stugor/leder/broar page listed other notices but no Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs hiking closure or Vindelälven/Rävfallet bridge closure as of 2026-04-30. The page itself warns it may not be comprehensive.
Reserve rules prohibit disturbing wildlife, disturbing reindeer husbandry, damaging natural features and unauthorized motorized travel.

Vindelfjällen rules prohibit entering the Marsivagge bird-protection area 15 May-1 Aug. The route description passes Marsivaggie/Marsivagge context, and the official map shows the closed polygon west/northwest of Ammarnäs.

Dogs must be under strict control. Naturvårdsverket guidance effectively requires dogs not to run loose 1 Mar-20 Aug; extra care is needed around grazing animals and reindeer land. Vindelfjällen guidance says loose dogs are threats to reindeer.

Länsstyrelsen notice dated 2026-03-30 and updated 2026-03-31 16:47 says reindeer are grazing around Ammarnäs-Björkfjället-Skeble and advises choosing another way. It appears in snowmobile restriction context and is not a hiker ban.
State mountain small-game hunting has seasonal permit rules and dynamic closures. 2026 moose-hunt dates found were 1-14 Sep, 15-18 Oct and 22-25 Oct. No active hiking closure found on 2026-04-30.

State-water fishing requires fish card and local rules. Fjällfiske 2026 lists Vindelälven from Rävfallet to Nedre Framakselet as trout water open all year, no bait fishing, max three fish/day, card activation required and quota six fishers/day.

Länsstyrelsen notices on 2026-04-16 and 2026-03-26 warned of early removal of winter route stakes, much bare ground, opening streams, rapid thaw, remaining higher-terrain snow, open watercourses, springs and weak lake ice.

SMHI SNOW1 point forecast for Ammarnäs at reference 2026-04-30T00:30Z had +4 to +8 C daytime, no precipitation, NW gusts up to about 16 m/s in the morning and low cloud early; no Västerbotten mountain wind warning was active. Always recheck before start.

conditionReports.summary: Describes steep start after Rävfallet bridge, long climb before tree line, flatter hilltop walking, no water before a large lake camp, very steep and uneven ski-slope-like descent, and Stabburet/Näsbergs shelter context.
Reverse-direction report says ski-slope climb out of Ammarnäs was fairly steep and found bivouac options across bridge/forest near Rävfallsstugan.
Recorded 26 km from 08:40-15:00 with long initial uphill, drizzle and strong wind above tree line.

Reports storm exposure above Rävfallsstugan, water refill after the climb and expectation of little/no more water before Ammarnäs; also documents direct valley route after weather damage rather than official Kungsleden route.
Reports good tent spots near Rävfallsstugan are rare, contradicting some earlier bivouac reports.

Multiple reports agree on limited reliable running water on the exposed upland, wind sensitivity, bugs/midges around wet/forest areas in early August, and unclear/unmarked final Ammarnäs village approach.

sourceContradictions.details: STF gives 23 km and WFS LED.2784003 measures 23.334 km to the Ammarnäs ledstart/parking area. Naturkartan gives 21.0 km, its GPX measures about 21.252 km, OSM extraction about 21.558 km and Gaia about 21.1 km, all apparently ending near Näsberget/ski-slope access and omitting the unmarked village/ledstart stretch.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use WFS LED.2784003 reversed if preserving STF 23 km stage identity; keep Naturkartan/OSM shorter line as alternate endpoint interpretation.

sourceContradictions.details: Official section is Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs, but the shorter route line ends near Näsberget while the WFS 23 km line reaches the ledstart/parking area across/near the next-section boundary. Naturkartan also says the village trail is unmarked.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Model endpoint as an Ammarnäs endpoint zone with Näsberget arrival, village services and ledstart/parking connector, rather than a single silently-snapped point.

sourceContradictions.details: The WFS route endpoint is about 88-94 m from the Rävfallsstugan hut/facility point and likely represents trail/bridge approach rather than cabin centroid.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Keep route endpoint and hut facility as related but distinct records unless normalization chooses to snap hut endpoints.

sourceContradictions.details: Official Naturkartan/section-20 evidence supports a locked cabin/safety-space model, while local/field sources mention 18 beds, sauna, key via Ammarnäs Livs and other service details.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official cabin/safety-space source for import; attach sauna/key details only where directly sourced and mark currentness caveat.

sourceContradictions.details: A 2021 field report found good bivouac options across bridge/forest, while a 2025 route-app note says good tent spots near the cabin are rare.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Do not import a campsite POI near Rävfallsstugan; keep as narrative caveat.

sourceContradictions.details: The Marsivagge bird-protection area has a real 15 May-1 Aug entry ban, but this does not automatically close the entire Rävfallsstugan-Ammarnäs stage. Route intersection with the closed polygon was not proven in this pass.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Add nearby seasonal exclusion warning; do not close whole section unless final selected geometry intersects the polygon.

sourceContradictions.details: The 2026-03-30 Länsstyrelsen notice advises choosing another way around Ammarnäs-Björkfjället-Skeble, but it appears under snowmobile restriction/local exemption context rather than as a hiking closure.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Import as date-sensitive reindeer sensitivity/currentness note, not as route closure.

sourceContradictions.details: Shelter and firepit have OSM plus field-report support; toilet is field-only without a source-backed coordinate.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Shelter/firepit can be pending or imported only if OSM-supported POIs are accepted; toilet should remain pending.

researchIterations.type: six-agent parallel batch with replacement facilities lane

lanes.summary: Confirmed section identity, order, STF 23 km / 8-10 h versus Naturkartan 21.0 km / 8-10 h, route narrative, protected/admin context, official facilities and Karsbäcken connector caveat.
Recommended WFS LED.2784003/AC20 reversed as primary 23.334 km geometry, with Naturkartan/OSM/Gaia shorter Näsberget endpoint interpretation documented.
Original facilities lane failed from context-window exhaustion before reporting; coordinator closed it and spawned a replacement.
Collected Rävfallet/Rävfallsstugan facilities, AC20 bridges, Stabburet, Näsbergs pending cluster, Ammarnäs village services and suppressions for side/next-section features.
Confirmed no direct access at Rävfallsstugan, Höbäcken roadhead-only access, and Ammarnäs bus/lodging/grocery/parking service endpoint via Sorsele.
Synthesized steep climb/descent, exposed/windy plateau, water scarcity, bugs, shortcut ambiguity, Rävfallsstugan camping contradiction and Ammarnäs approach confusion.
Found no route-specific closure on 2026-04-30; documented Vindelfjällen, Marsivagge bird area, dog/reindeer, hunting/fishing, fire risk, spring thaw and weather-currentness caveats.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Complete enough for research-ready candidate file. No targeted follow-up batch needed before moving to section 22. Remaining work is final source/licensing policy, endpoint convention, protected-area polygon overlay, and date-sensitive currentness checks.

openQuestions: For normalized app display, choose whether section 21 ends at Näsberget/ski-slope access using the shorter Naturkartan/OSM line or at the Ammarnäs ledstart/parking using WFS LED.2784003 and STF 23 km distance.
Run final selected-line overlay against Marsivagge bird-protection polygon before attaching any seasonal restriction to the section.

Verify current Rävfallsstugan key/fee/sauna details, Ammarnäs service hours, bus timetable, fire bans, bridge notices, hunting/reindeer notices and weather immediately before runtime import/public use.
Decide whether OSM-supported Näsbergs shelter/firepit and Näsberget slalomback parking belong in the app taxonomy; keep Näsbergs toilet pending until a coordinate is sourced.
Decide whether village services in Ammarnäs should be attached to this section, the next section, or a shared trail-town/service hub.
